identity.name: Scott Bales
identity.positioning_statement: A global leader in the cutting-edge arena known as 'The Digital Shift', encompassing innovation, culture, design, and mobility in a world gone digital.
identity.mission: Driving positive human impact through technology application

publications.title: Mobile Ready: Connecting With The Untethered Consumer
publications.description: Addresses how 6+ billion mobile devices globally have created a new ecosystem changing consumer mindset and behavior.

publications.title: Innovation Wars: Unlocking the Secrets of Corporate Innovation
publications.description: New business designs, tools, and frameworks for leaders to steer organizations towards success through self-reflection, experimentation, and value proposition discovery.

speaking_topics.title: Recode Leadership (Recode Your Leadership)
speaking_topics.description: Navigating challenges of the digital economy through a transformational leadership framework covering Reskill, Retool, Reinvent, and Recode approaches for digital-first workforces.
key_takeaways: Case studies on developing self-awareness and reinvention strategies
Guidance for modern leaders adapting to technology-saturated markets

speaking_topics.title: Innovation Wars
speaking_topics.description: Competitive innovation edge for modern organizations. Greater than 65% of corporate executives see innovation as the key to market success.
key_takeaways: Analysis of innovation success vs. failure in corporate settings

speaking_topics.title: Smart Cities & Digital Citizens (Future Cities)
speaking_topics.description: Exploring smart city evolution, IoT, artificial intelligence, and autonomous vehicles through the lens of digital citizens.
key_takeaways: Evolution of smart cities through digital citizen perspectives
Understanding technology trends reshaping infrastructure and societies

speaking_topics.title: The Future Consumer (Are You Ready for Isaac?)
speaking_topics.description: Understanding digital natives (Millennials/Gen Z), their expectations for transparency and authenticity, and actionable engagement strategies.
key_takeaways: Understanding transparency, authenticity, and utility preferences
Engagement strategies for Millennial and Gen Z consumers

speaking_topics.title: The Future of Work
speaking_topics.description: Addressing hybrid/remote work models, digital natives in workforce, and advanced productivity technologies for post-pandemic success.

speaking_topics.title: Empowering Potential
speaking_topics.description: Technology's role in accessibility and diversity, blending personal experience raising a child with special needs with professional expertise.
key_takeaways: Emerging tech (AI, VR/AR, voice recognition) for inclusion

speaking_topics.title: Blockchain, Big Data and Bitcoin
speaking_topics.description: Demystifies emerging technologies and demonstrates fit-for-purpose approaches. From buzzwords to boardrooms.

testimonials.quote: Scott's content and stage presence are first class.
